title: Unposted findings of an abandoned review suppress the finding on later heads
description: Spec: docs/spec/technical-spec.md#161-testing (Chaos). pipeline.Finish stores findings meant for posting with state 'posted' before Post runs. If the review never reaches GitHub (superseded after Finish, or killed at post-review/before and then superseded on retry), those rows stay 'posted' with gh_comment_id NULL. OpenFindings feeds them into PostedFingerprints on every later head, so the finding is dropped as a duplicate and never posted. The worker sim reproduces it: EXEMPLAR_SIM_SEED=20 and =38 go test -run 'TestWorkerSim$' -v ./internal/worker fail liveness (0 comments after the drain). A fix must still not repost when the POST landed but comment mapping was lost (a complete-check/after kill, then a push: comment on GitHub, gh_comment_id NULL). Only the review marker on GitHub distinguishes these two cases. Acceptance: sim seeds 1-40 green.
close_reason: bc852a6a (branch claude/exemplar-9iz-0c563e): before reviewing, open findings with no comment id are checked against GitHub by their review's marker; a missing marker records them dropped/not_posted. CarryableRuns flags runs with a not_posted finding and PlanCarry re-runs them; InsertFinding lets a retry decide a not_posted finding again. A landed post with lost mapping keeps its marker and stays open (no double post). Tested by TestUnpostedFindingPostsOnNextHead (3 cases), a PlanCarry case, and worker sim seeds 1-60 green. Known gap: a review elsewhere between Finish and its post can lose its findings to this check and re-gain them via mapping; narrow race, documented on dropUnposted.

description: Spec: docs/spec/technical-spec.md#161-testing. Direction: no injected clocks, tests use testing/synctest (internal/worker and internal/mergesafety done in exemplar-9iz.13). Still injected: Config.Now in internal/learn/propose, internal/learn/pathevents, internal/setup, internal/search/index, internal/api (links, evaluate, signin), internal/precheck; Runner.Now in internal/learn/demote, digest, expiry; Checker.Now in internal/ghuser; Verifier.Now in internal/svcauth.
close_reason: Removed injected clocks in internal/learn (propose, pathevents, demote, digest, expiry), internal/api (Config.Now, EvalConfig.Now), internal/ghuser, internal/setup (Config.Now, Checker.Now), internal/search/index, internal/precheck (VolumeConfig.Now), internal/svcauth; all call time.Now. Clock-dependent tests run in synctest bubbles slept to their fixed dates; api, ghuser and svcauth tests serve handlers through in-memory transports so bubble time can advance. search/index tests backdate LastFull/behindSince instead (zoekt's watcher sits in kqueue, so bubble time cannot move). title: Worker sim: time cannot advance mid-run (claim expiry untested)
description: Spec: docs/spec/technical-spec.md#161-testing. The sim runs in a synctest bubble slept to wall time at start, but the fake GitHub (httptest, real TCP) and Postgres keep goroutines in network I/O, which are never durably blocked, so time.Sleep inside the run would hang: token and claim expiry cannot be exercised. RedeemRunnerClaim also checks expires_at against Postgres now(), not Go time. Options: in-memory transport for the fake (net.Pipe) and passing the time to the redeem query.

title: Worker sim: supersede mid-review
description: Spec: docs/spec/technical-spec.md#161-testing (Chaos). Add a newer-head push step to internal/worker/sim_test.go: River remote cancel of the running job, ExitSuperseded, superseded check run completed, nothing posted on the old head.
close_reason: Worker sim (internal/worker/sim_test.go, branch claude/exemplar-9iz-0c563e, commit after bc852a6a): pushes to a newer head between runs and mid-review (start-check, pre-post PR read, post; plus a delayed cancel at start-check), routed as EventWorker does (ReviewJobsToSupersede + JobCancelTx + insert in one tx), River's cancel played via the Work context's cancel cause. Asserts ExitSuperseded/cancelled (completed when delayed), review row superseded, the run's check run completed Superseded, and nothing posted on a head after a push left it. liveJobs scoped to the current head; CI seeds now 1-5 and 8 (8 covers start-check). env.push split into commit + push. title: FR-A13: a clean run ignores suggestion findings
description: Brief: docs/plans/backlog.md#auto-approve-gates-adopted-not-built, row FR-A13. Spec: docs/spec/technical-spec.md#613-auto-approve. Order: H2.
close_reason: Built on branch claude/clean-run-suggestions: Stage1Input.Candidates now counts only blocking/important or Security-category candidates (before verification, so a refuted one still blocks); CandidatesAll keeps the total in the trace. Carried runs count the origin run's gating findings in SQL (CarryableRuns.candidates_gating; a Security rule's count whole), so no candidates_by_severity column. Verdict reason reads 'N blocking or important finding(s)'; an approval with posted suggestions says so in the check run and the APPROVE body; merge-policy text no longer claims nothing was flagged. Tests: gates, gating table, carry, verdict, approve body, interdiff. Docs: how a review works, trust and data, why, landing page, auto-approve guide, spec schema note.

close_reason: Built on branch claude/search-off-scope-line: on an install without exemplar-search (engine.Result.SearchOff) the check-run summary ends with 'Cross-repository callers were not checked (search is not configured).' and names context.extra_repos as not searched (pipeline.scopeNote); the PR review body is unchanged. Tested by TestScopeNote and the worker review test. Docs: how a review works, without-search how-to, troubleshoot, spec 6.4.6 status. Local find_references/path_history remain in exemplar-uww.3.

title: Local find_references and path_history without exemplar-search
description: Spec: docs/spec/technical-spec.md#646-running-without-exemplar-search. Brief: docs/plans/backlog.md#review-pipeline, row "Local find_references and path_history without exemplar-search". Order: H1 (docs/plans/backlog.md#order-of-work).
close_reason: Built on branch claude/local-references: without exemplar-search (Engine.WithLocalContext, wired when EXEMPLAR_SEARCH_URL is empty) find_references answers from the review's checkout (rg -w -F over the head, universal-ctags for definitions, ranked by proximity to defined_in, capped at 50, says other repositories were not searched) and path_history from the checkout's git log (deepened once by 200 commits on first use) plus path_events. bug.contract runs on local answers unless context.extra_repos is set, when it is degraded_skip naming them and the uncovered bug lane blocks auto-approve. Tests: localrefs and workspace log tests, engine contract and local-tool tests, a worker review test for both cases, pathhistory WithCommits. Not verified: git fetch --deepen against GitHub (local fixtures refuse fetch by SHA), rg/ctags speed on a monorepo.
